items.title: Replace pre-run dollar cap with frozen execution envelope and postflight usage accounting
items.context: Do not require the human to guess a dollar amount before the run. Freeze Cell 03 execution bounds instead: exact cell scope, row/task count, model snapshots, max retries, timeout, max input/output tokens, and stop conditions. After execution, record provider-reported usage and derived cost separately from any estimate.
items.userSees: `Cell 03 execution envelope: frozen`; `Pre-run dollar guess: not required`; `Postflight usage accounting: provider-reported usage required after execution`.

happy.desc: Run m2-provider-execution-check.mjs and verify it reports Cell 03 execution envelope: frozen plus Pre-run dollar guess: not required.

edge.desc: A preflight estimate may exist, but provider-reported usage remains required postflight and estimates are not final usage.

adversarial.desc: Missing retry/time/token/output bounds or treating estimates as final usage must be rejected and keep provider calls disabled.
